title: Anne Graham Lotz
fact: A ministry site on headless WordPress, with devotions, articles, Bible studies, videos and search across all of it.

story.brief: Anne Graham Lotz’s ministry publishes articles, videos and study resources. It needed a fast site where readers could find them.
story.did: The site runs on headless WordPress with an Astro front end on Cloudflare Workers. I wrote the data layer over the WordPress REST API, the reusable block system, a caching system that purges by tag on publish, multilingual routing, Algolia search, gated content and the deploy pipeline.

title: Azul
fact: A Java company’s WordPress marketing site, with five years of work and a Craft CMS and Astro rebuild underway.

story.brief: Azul builds and supports Java for large companies. For five years the focus has been its WordPress marketing site, from major campaigns to everyday upkeep. That work continues while a Craft CMS and Astro rebuild is underway.
story.did: Since 2022, I’ve developed pages and features for Azul’s WordPress site alongside other developers. I’m now building its Craft CMS and Astro replacement with the team, including the content move from WordPress.

title: Puck News
fact: A paid news site rebuilt from WordPress in Rails, with stories, newsletters, podcasts and subscriptions.

story.brief: Puck is a subscription news company covering Wall Street, Washington, A.I. and Hollywood. The move from WordPress to a Rails codebase shared with Air Mail meant rebuilding the entire site readers and subscribers use.
story.did: I led Puck’s front end through its move from WordPress to Rails, across the news, join, sign in and admin sites. That includes the shared ViewComponent library, Stimulus interactions and the pages for stories, newsletters, podcasts and search.

title: Air Mail
fact: A weekly publication on Rails, with news and culture stories, travel guides, arts events, a shop and paid subscriptions.

story.brief: Air Mail sends readers a new issue every week, and its site also covers travel, the arts and shopping. The site has to make all of it feel like one publication.
story.did: Since 2023, I’ve developed most of Air Mail’s Rails front end with the team, using ViewComponent and Stimulus across navigation, section pages, search, subscriptions and the shop. My work also includes sitewide light and dark themes, a Connections inspired word game and a tournament bracket.

title: Esses Magazine
fact: A print and digital Grand Prix magazine built on Astro and headless Craft CMS, with issues, stories, a paywall, Stripe checkout and reader accounts.

story.brief: Esses is a print and digital magazine about the world of Grand Prix racing. It needed a site that tells its stories well and sells subscriptions directly to readers.
story.did: The site runs on headless Craft CMS with an Astro front end on Cloudflare Workers. I wrote the Craft API integration, tiered gated content, the paywall, Stripe checkout, reader accounts and a Durable Object caching system that purges on publish.

title: Perry Weather
fact: A WordPress marketing site for weather safety software using Twig and ACF blocks, with interactive product demos, pricing and partner search.

story.brief: Perry Weather makes weather safety software. Its redesign needed to show the product in action and let the marketing team manage content with reusable blocks.
story.did: The site runs on a custom WordPress theme with Twig templates, reusable ACF blocks and a Vite build. Since 2024, I’ve worked across the full stack, from PHP block controllers and the REST API to Twig templates, GSAP animation, video, pricing, forms and Core Web Vitals.

title: Kioti
fact: A Craft CMS site for a tractor and utility vehicle maker, with product filters, model comparison and owner manuals.

story.brief: Kioti makes tractors, mowers and utility vehicles. Its site needed to help buyers filter the range and compare models before visiting a dealer.
story.did: The site runs on Craft CMS with Twig templates, a custom PHP module and a Vite build. From the first commit in 2022, I worked across the full stack, from the content model and custom module to API driven product filters, model comparison, owner manuals, Twig components and reusable page sections.

title: Rockit Apple
fact: Built the entire front end of Rockit Apple’s WordPress site, with playful motion to match the brand.

story.brief: Rockit sells small apples in a tube with a playful brand, and the site needed to feel the same.
story.did: I built the front end from the ground up, every page, layout and interaction, with motion throughout.
